import unittest

from app import bulk, db, projects, tasks, users


class BulkTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sets_status(self):
        con = db.connect()
        ann = users.create_user(con, "ann@example.com", "Ann")
        pid = projects.create_project(con, ann, "Alpha")
        ids = [tasks.add_task(con, pid, f"t{i}") for i in range(3)]
        bulk.bulk_set_status(con, ann, ids, "done")
        self.assertEqual({t["status"] for t in tasks.list_tasks(con, pid)}, {"done"})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest

from app import auth, db, users


class AuthTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.con = db.connect()
        auth.setup(self.con)
        self.ann = users.create_user(self.con, "ann@example.com", "Ann")
        auth.set_password(self.con, self.ann, "s3cret")

    def test_login(self):
        token = auth.login(self.con, self.ann, "s3cret")
        self.assertEqual(auth.current_user(self.con, token), self.ann)

    def test_change_password(self):
        token = auth.login(self.con, self.ann, "s3cret")
        auth.change_password(self.con, token, "n3w")
        auth.login(self.con, self.ann, "n3w")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
